# Context Harness — A toolkit for context-aware agents

> A toolkit for context-aware agents. Combine searchable knowledge, live tools, and controlled execution—or bring context to your existing AI assistant.

Build agents around shared context and selected tools. Use Context Harness to own execution, connect a compatible existing assistant over MCP, or embed the runtime in an application.

## Start here

- [Build an agent](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/agents/build-local-agents/): Configure a model, indexed context, selected tools, and execution limits; run a focused task and inspect activity.
- [Connect your assistant](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/getting-started/quick-start/): Index selected documents and expose context over MCP while your client owns the conversation and its tools.
- [Embed the runtime](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/agents/embed-an-agent-host/): Compose agent execution and durable tasks with application events, policies, and result delivery.

## Key Capabilities

- **Extension registry**: install community connectors for Jira, Confluence, Slack, RSS, and more from Git-backed registries
- **Connector-driven ingestion**: filesystem, Git, S3, and custom Lua scripts
- **SQLite storage**: SQLite with WAL mode, FTS5 full-text search, and optional vector embeddings (local fastembed/tract, Ollama, or OpenAI)
- **Hybrid search**: BM25 keyword scoring + cosine semantic scoring with configurable alpha blending
- **MCP server**: Streamable HTTP endpoint for Cursor, Claude Desktop, and any MCP-compatible agent
- **Reusable profiles**: named external-client roles, tool suggestions, arguments, and optional startup context without taking over the conversation
- **Local agent runtime**: direct or queued project agents with scoped tools, cumulative budgets, typed outcomes, approvals, durable history, bounded context, checkpoints, and recovery
- **Local generation**: native loopback-only Ollama chat with no redirects, model download, or silent cloud fallback
- **Durable tasks**: idempotent submission, bounded workers, claims, leases, cancellation, and conservative task/run reconciliation
- **Application host APIs**: explicit compiled provider/tool registration and bounded targeted refresh for host-known changed documents
- **Declarative tool bindings**: compose scoped public tools over trusted built-in, Rust, Lua, and MCP implementations
- **Lua extensibility**: custom connectors and agent tools without recompiling Rust
- **CLI-first**: Unix-composable `ctx` commands for init, sync, search, serve, and more

## Documentation

- [Search your project documents](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/getting-started/quick-start/): Index local documents, verify keyword search, and optionally connect an AI client
- [Installation](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/getting-started/installation/): Install from release binaries or choose another supported installation option
- [Configuration Reference](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/reference/configuration/): Complete ctx.toml reference for db, chunking, embedding, retrieval, server, and connectors
- [CLI Reference](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/reference/cli/): Every ctx command, flag, and option
- [Search & Retrieval](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/reference/search/): Keyword, semantic, and hybrid search modes with scoring and tuning
- [MCP Server API](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/reference/mcp-server/): HTTP API reference for AI agent integration
- [Deployment](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/reference/deployment/): Docker, systemd, CI/CD, and static site deployment

## Agents

- [Agents Overview](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/agents/overview/): Run bounded, inspectable AI workflows against local project context
- [Build Local Agents](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/agents/build-local-agents/): Configure models, scoped tools, permissions, history, and recovery
- [Use the Agent Setup Skill](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/agents/setup-skill/): Install and invoke the Codex skill that configures and validates local agents
- [Embed an Agent Host](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/agents/embed-an-agent-host/): Compose trusted providers, scoped tools, tasks, workers, runs, and targeted refresh through public Rust APIs

## Profiles

- [Profiles Overview](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/profiles/overview/): Give external AI clients a reusable role, tool set, and project-aware starting context
- [Define Profiles](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/profiles/define-profiles/): Create inline, Lua, Rust, or standalone-agent-projected MCP prompts

## Guides

- [Connect External AI Clients](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/guides/agent-integration/): Connect Cursor, Claude Desktop, Continue.dev, and custom applications
- [Cursor & IDE Integration](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/guides/cursor-extension/): Workspace-level context for Cursor, VS Code, and JetBrains
- [Connect the repositories behind your change](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/guides/multi-repo/): Configure related repositories in one index and make their source and documentation searchable from your coding assistant
- [Build a RAG Agent](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/guides/rag-agent/): Python agent with search, retrieval, and grounded answers
- [Build a Chatbot](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/guides/chatbot/): TypeScript chatbot with streaming and conversation history

- [Registry Overview](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/registry/overview/): How Git-backed extension registries work

## Connectors

- [Built-in Connectors](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/connectors/built-in/): Filesystem, Git, and S3
- [Lua Connectors](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/connectors/lua-connectors/): Custom data source connectors in Lua (GitHub Issues, Confluence, Notion, Slack)
- [Lua Tools](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/connectors/lua-tools/): Custom MCP tools in Lua that agents discover and call at runtime
- [Rust Traits](https://parallax-labs.github.io/context-harness/docs/connectors/rust-traits/): Extend with compiled Rust connectors, tools, and agents
